title: blob_exists defaults true: intentional backward-compat, defensible
description: backend.rs blob_exists has a default impl returning true. This preserves pre-existing behavior: all parse failures route to notParsable rather than notFound. The doc comment explains this explicitly. A future contributor might 'simplify' it to default false (to be 'safe'). Defend: false would silently break backends that don't yet implement blob_exists by reporting notFound for all parse attempts, which is worse than notParsable for blobs that do exist.
